name: Blue Ridge Communications
notes: Researched from public customersupport.brctv.com help articles (read through the public Help Center article API because the HTML pages return 403 to the fetcher; no sign-in, no forms). My Blue Ridge registration: account number (9 digits with leading zeroes and hyphen) and ZIP code, a security check (security questions or security code), then username, password and email; usernames may match the email. Passwords: more than 8 and fewer than 50 characters with upper, lower, number and special character, no username. Two-Factor Authentication is required for every account by text or email (mfa email_or_sms); passkeys are optional. Payment options: online with My Blue Ridge (web or app), automated phone or live agent by card, local office, or mail; no charge for any payment option. Online payments can be scheduled for a later day (Pay a Different Day) and process within one business day. No pay-without-signing-in option is described, so guest_pay is unsupported (inferred) with the free phone line. AutoPay posts a pending payment the day the bill runs and processes it on the due date; turning it off after the bill generated does not stop that pending payment; AutoPay only starts with the next bill. Paperless: emails each bill, last 12 bills online; $5 monthly AP discount needs both AutoPay and Paperless Billing plus Blue Ridge internet. Due dates are the 7th, 16th, 23rd or 30th by install date; changing them needs a zero balance and is not possible during a promotion. Disconnects: no online flow is described (authorized users cannot disconnect an account in full), so cancel_service is unsupported online (inferred) with the residential number; seasonal suspension needs a 30-day minimum. Non-pay reconnection is $54.95. Late fees for cable/internet are not published (Blue Ridge Mobile's $6.95 is a different product) and are left out. Reviewer (t20, 2026-10-10): Re-checked all ten cited articles through the public article API plus Installation & Labor Rates (added as a source: Non-Pay Reconnection $54.95, Reactivation $24.95, now in fee notes and a reconnection article). All other claims matched.

passwordRule.message: Use more than 8 and fewer than 50 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character.

guest_pay.note: Online payments need a My Blue Ridge account. You can also pay by phone at 1-800-222-5377 (automated system or a live agent), at your local office or by mail, with no charge.

autopay.note: AutoPay starts with your next bill, so pay any current balance first. Each bill's payment is posted as pending when the bill runs and processed on the due date.

autopay_cancel.note: If you unenroll after this month's bill has generated, the pending payment for that bill still processes.

cancel_service.note: To disconnect Blue Ridge service, the account holder calls Blue Ridge at 1-800-222-5377. Away for a while? Ask about a seasonal suspension instead.

notes: Reconnecting service after a disconnection for nonpayment costs $54.95, collected before reconnection.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Pay online with your My Blue Ridge account on the web or in the app, by phone through the automated system, with a live agent by credit or debit card, at your local office, or by mail. AutoPay and Paperless Billing are available too. None of these options cost anything extra.

Online, sign in and choose Make a Payment, enter the amount, and pick a later date if you want to schedule it. Choose a saved method or add a bank account or card, review the terms and select Make Payment. Payments process within one business day and a receipt goes to your email.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay posts a pending payment to your account on the day your new bill runs and processes it on your due date. It takes effect with the next bill, so if you have a balance now you will be asked to pay it first.

On the web, sign in and click Enroll in AutoPay under your balance (or Billing, then Enroll in AutoPay), choose or add a payment method, review the terms and enroll. In the app, use Menu, Billing, Manage Auto Pay.
To stop it, choose Manage AutoPay and Unenroll. If you unenroll or change the payment method after this month's bill has generated, that bill's pending payment still goes to the previous method.
steps: Sign in to My Blue Ridge.
Click Enroll in AutoPay under your balance.
Choose or add a payment method.
Review the terms and click Enroll in AutoPay.

help.title: Paperless billing and the AP discount
paragraphs: Paperless billing emails you each month when your bill is ready, with a link to view it; your last 12 bills stay online. Sign in, click Enroll in Paperless Billing, enter an email and confirm it from the email Blue Ridge sends.

Blue Ridge gives a $5 monthly discount (the AP Discount) to customers enrolled in both AutoPay and Paperless Billing who also subscribe to Blue Ridge internet. It applies within 24 hours of meeting the conditions.

help.title: Billing cycles and due dates
paragraphs: Depending on your installation date your bill is due on the 7th, 16th, 23rd or 30th of the month. You can ask to change your billing cycle when your balance is zero; the next bill is prorated. Due dates cannot be changed while a promotion is active.

help.title: Seasonal accounts
paragraphs: If you will be away, a seasonal account turns service off for an extended time and you are not charged for deactivated services. Services must stay active or deactivated for at least 30 days at a time. Contact Blue Ridge at 1-800-222-5377 to set it up or to disconnect service.

help.title: Two-factor authentication
paragraphs: Every My Blue Ridge account must use two-factor authentication. After your password, you get a code by text message or email. Passkeys using your device's fingerprint or face recognition are also available, except in the Android app.

help.title: Reconnection charges
paragraphs: If service is disconnected for nonpayment, a $54.95 Non-Pay Reconnection charge is collected before service is turned back on. Reactivating service otherwise costs $24.95; if a technician has to come inside to reinstall equipment, a technician visit and installation rates apply.

extra.intent: Using Blue Ridge's help, find the monthly discount for using both AutoPay and Paperless Billing. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: A $5 monthly AP Discount (AutoPay plus Paperless Billing, with Blue Ridge internet).
